## 1.

```{r}
library(RSQLite)

conn <- dbConnect(SQLite(), "database (1).sqlite3")
dbListTables(conn)
```

## 2.

```{r}
profs_stat <- dbGetQuery(conn, "SELECT DISTINCT i.id, i.name FROM instructors i
  JOIN teachings t            ON t.instructor_id = i.id
  JOIN sections s             ON s.uuid = t.section_uuid
  JOIN subject_memberships sm ON sm.course_offering_uuid = s.course_offering_uuid
  JOIN subjects su            ON su.code = sm.subject_code
  WHERE su.abbreviation = 'STAT'
  ORDER BY i.name
")
profs_stat

dbGetQuery(conn, "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) AS n_professores FROM instructors i
  JOIN teachings t            ON t.instructor_id = i.id
  JOIN sections s             ON s.uuid = t.section_uuid
  JOIN subject_memberships sm ON sm.course_offering_uuid = s.course_offering_uuid
  JOIN subjects su            ON su.code = sm.subject_code
  WHERE su.abbreviation = 'STAT'
")
```

## 3.

```{r}
base <- "SELECT
    i.id   AS instructor_id,
    i.name AS instructor,
    c.uuid AS course_uuid,
    c.name AS course,
    c.number AS course_number,
    (4.0*gd.a_count + 3.5*gd.ab_count + 3.0*gd.b_count + 2.5*gd.bc_count
      + 2.0*gd.c_count + 1.0*gd.d_count + 0.0*gd.f_count) AS pontos,
    (gd.a_count + gd.ab_count + gd.b_count + gd.bc_count
      + gd.c_count + gd.d_count + gd.f_count) AS alunos
  FROM grade_distributions gd
  JOIN sections s             ON s.course_offering_uuid = gd.course_offering_uuid
                             AND s.number = gd.section_number
  JOIN teachings t            ON t.section_uuid = s.uuid
  JOIN instructors i          ON i.id = t.instructor_id
  JOIN course_offerings co    ON co.uuid = s.course_offering_uuid
  JOIN courses c              ON c.uuid = co.course_uuid
  JOIN subject_memberships sm ON sm.course_offering_uuid = co.uuid
  JOIN subjects su            ON su.code = sm.subject_code
  WHERE su.abbreviation = 'STAT'
"

gpa_prof <- dbGetQuery(conn, paste0("
  SELECT instructor, SUM(pontos)/SUM(alunos) AS gpa, SUM(alunos) AS total_alunos
  FROM (", base, ")
  GROUP BY instructor_id, instructor
  HAVING SUM(alunos) > 0
  ORDER BY gpa ASC
"))

prof_mais_dificil <- head(gpa_prof, 1)
prof_mais_facil   <- tail(gpa_prof, 1)

gpa_disc <- dbGetQuery(conn, paste0("
  SELECT course_number, course, SUM(pontos)/SUM(alunos) AS gpa, SUM(alunos) AS total_alunos
  FROM (", base, ")
  GROUP BY course_uuid, course, course_number
  HAVING SUM(alunos) > 0
  ORDER BY gpa ASC
"))

disc_mais_dificil <- head(gpa_disc, 1)
disc_mais_facil   <- tail(gpa_disc, 1)

prof_mais_dificil; prof_mais_facil
disc_mais_dificil; disc_mais_facil
```
